player_prompt.intro:
O modiri {player_id} mo SimpleTak.
Ka boro, mafela a gago a bonwa e le '{player_stone}'  le mafela a modiribodi a gago a bonwa e le '{opponent_stone}'.

Ka tshepo ya gago, kgetha sello e se nago le (ka index e nago phefo)  le hloma sello sa gago moo.
E le ka mohlala, '[12]' se hloma sello sa gago sekelling 12.

Mmušo wa gago ke wa hloma mafela a gago a a tsamayanang a a kgona go kopantša merako ya bobedi ya boro (ka kgauswi le kgauswi goba ka lehwatateng le lehwatateng).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nomoro ya sele e sa šomego {cell_num}. E swanetše go ba magareng ga 0 le {max_board_num} .
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sele {cell_num} e šetše e na le motho. Kgetha sele yeo e se nago selo.

action.placement: Modiri {current_player_id} o hlomeletše semelo sa gagwe ({symbol}) sekelling {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Modiri {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') o kopantšitše merako ya bobedi ya tšona!
outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
